etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English produce, from Latin prōdūcō (“to lead forth”), from prō- (“forth, forward”) + dūcō (“to lead, bring”). The noun is derived from the verb.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To bring forth, to yield, make, manufacture, or otherwise generate.
